name: newsh2-191
summary: Spinning arch: a horseshoe-shaped round tube band, segmented bronze over the top and grey metal down the two straight legs (dark collars at rows 7 and 12, darker lower legs ending in a point), with a bronze barrel pod hung in the middle of the arch on two short grey struts. Polished metal, round tubes and a round barrel; the eight frames turn it about the vertical axis.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: round tube of constant diameter, about 3 px across and as deep, bending over the top
the same thickness as the grey legs it continues into
features.note: The top of the horseshoe; the sprite's lit left corners and dark right corners are its drawn light.

traits: round barrel about 6-7 px across, rows 6-14, standing about as tall as it is wide
flat-ish top, narrowing to a small rounded bottom end (row 13)
features.note: The barrel hung in the middle of the arch; the concept draws it as a riveted bronze capsule with rims.

traits: straight round grey tube, constant 3 px diameter, rows 6-19
lighter grey above row 12, darker grey below
ends in a short taper/point at row 19
mirror of the left leg: straight round grey tube, constant diameter
ends in a point at row 19
features.note: Right leg of the horseshoe; drawn darker in the sprite only because it is the shadow side.

traits: dark raised rings round both legs at rows 7 and 12
slightly wider than the leg tube, about 1 px long
features.note: Dark grey (4-6) pixel rows across the legs.

traits: two short round grey bars at row 10 joining the legs to the pod
a dark joint where each meets its leg (columns 6 and 16)
features.note: The pod's mounts; the concept draws them as mechanical clamp joints.

traits: the bronze band reads as a row of segments with dark seams between them
a dark seam at the top centre (column 11)
features.note: Row 2's alternating light/dark bronze pixels; the concept draws the arch as bronze tiles with dark joints.
